name: H.P. Cotton Textile Mills Limited
about: H.P. Cotton Textile Mills Limited manufactures and sells cotton specialty yarns and cotton sewing threads in India and internationally. The company offers crochet, embroidery, lace, patchwork and quiliting, kite flying, cotton sewing, and mercerized cotton RFD threads; and hand knitting and hosiery yarns. It exports its products to approximately 40 countries. H.P. Cotton Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in New Delhi, India.
